profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Aptible
profile.summary:
I'm a full-stack developer with 15 years of experience building high-performance, highly distributed web applications and teams. I recently led the launch of Magic Notes, Quizlet's fastest-growing new product powered by AI, from concept to launch in less than three months.  

I've worked extensively in JavaScript/TypeScript (React, Redux, Node, etc), Python, PHP/Hack, Go, and Java.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: API Development · Technical Leadership · Mentoring · Front-End Development

positions.title: Tech Lead, Staff Fullstack Engineer
positions.description:
TL for acquisition and retention growth teams.

Led the development of Magic Notes, an AI-powered product that transforms notes into flashcards, outlines, and other helpful study tools. The product was launched in less than three months. It has maintained> 99% uptime and serves nearly 1M users, creating millions of notes monthly.

Founded the user growth platform team, which is now our Core Services team building the next-generation services at Quizlet.

Instrumented edge authentication service with encrypted JWTs to normalize internal service to service auth.
positions.insights: Skills: API Development · Technical Leadership · Mentoring · Front-End Development

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Improved landing page performance by 75%, increasing year-over-year organic visitors by 30%.

Developed high-performance components as part of the open-sourced Thumbprint design system and internal components, allowing developers to ship effective new marketing and landing pages quickly.
